pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Sub-polygonal dark brown regions with softened vertices and smooth pixel gradients. Patch geometry is irregularly sized and fragmented by foreground vegetation on the neck and shoulder.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected light-toned pathways forming a topological web between patches. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial. Continuity is maintained throughout visible neck regions despite foreground occlusion by dry brush.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette along the dorsal neck, consistent with a dense, short-haired mane. Individual structural fibers are not resolvable due to soft focus.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive foreground occlusion by dry, linear, thorny vegetation creates a complex geometric mask over the subject's primary features.
